title: David Ellison says AI could be the ‘biggest creative unlock in modern history’
slides: David Ellison bets AI is creativity's biggest unlock — but for whom?
Skydance's chief frames AI as a tool, not a replacement
The catch: access to these tools may concentrate power
Creators who master AI workflows gain leverage fast
Test one AI tool on your next project this week
thread_text:
1. Who Gets the Unlock?

David Ellison says AI is creativity's biggest unlock — but Skydance's chief frames it as a tool, not a replacement. The real question is who gets access.

2. Tool vs. Replacement

Ellison insists AI won't replace creators, just augment them. Yet history shows tools that concentrate power tend to reshape entire industries.

3. Access Is the Bottleneck

The catch: if only a few can afford cutting-edge AI, creativity's unlock becomes a gated community. Power concentrates fast when tools are scarce.

4. Workflow Advantage

Creators who master AI workflows gain leverage quickly — not by waiting for permission, but by shipping faster and experimenting. Early adopters set the rules.

5. Test One Tool Now

Pick one AI tool and use it on your next project this week. If you haven't tried it, that's your starting line.
